name: figma-to-tableau
description: Figma plugin that converts dashboard designs into downloadable Tableau .twbx workbooks (Tableau 2026.2).

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:code
scripts.test: tsx test/spec_smoke.ts && tsx test/lds_smoke.ts && tsx test/faithful_smoke.ts && tsx test/faithful_capture_smoke.ts && tsx test/faithful_features_smoke.ts && tsx test/faithful_multi_smoke.ts && tsx test/twb_import_smoke.ts
